title: Bass-knob picking, Banuelas's rubber hose act and Rittner in the theaters
summary: Manno has never heard of picking with the bow knob; he describes a Texas bassist who slapped with a rubber hose in a sombrero act, and Rittner's theater work.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
